featured_reviews.name: Gangesh Deshmukh Vlogs
featured_reviews.review_text:
You might wonder why the rating of this place is so low… I wondered the same too. 😅
The atmosphere is actually really nice. Good seating space, comfortable chairs, clean tables, and proper AC — honestly felt like any decent restaurant. In this hot summer, the AC was probably the best thing here. 🌞❄️
But the service completely ruined the experience.

The staff behaved like they just didn’t care. Had to ask 4 times just to get water. That itself says a lot.

We ordered Paratha and Idli — both were below average. The chutney served with the idli smelled bad, like it was kept for 2-3 days. 🤢 After that, we didn’t really feel like ordering anything else.

Good place only if you want to sit in AC for some time. Food and service definitely need improvement.

featured_reviews.name: Beingkeralite
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a wonderful experience at The Wings Restaurant, Virar West. The food was absolutely delicious — from the starters to the main course, every dish was full of taste and prepared with great care. The flavours were authentic, fresh, and perfectly balanced, making the entire dining experience memorable.

What truly made the visit special was the hospitality of the owner Mrs Rupali Thakur,  a very pleasant, humble, and soft-spoken lady who personally takes interest in understanding the taste and preferences of every customer who walks into the restaurant. You can genuinely feel the warmth and dedication with which the restaurant is run.

It was lovely speaking with the family as well. Since 2019, the entire family has been involved in building and managing this place with passion and hard work. Their daughter Kashish, who is also actively helping in the daily restaurant operations, is planning to pursue hotel management in the future — truly inspiring to see such dedication and family values together. Her husband too was very courteous and welcoming.

The ambience is comfortable, family-friendly, and they even have birthday hall facilities available for celebrations and gatherings.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for tasty food and heartfelt hospitality in Virar.

📍 Shop No. 6, Behind Punjab National Bank, Dongarpada Road, Virar West – 401303
📸 Instagram: @wings_restaurant_

Wishing the entire Wings family continued success and many more happy customers ahead!

featured_reviews.name: Only Truth
featured_reviews.review_text:
I usually avoid posting negative reviews. However, I feel it’s important to share this experience so others can make an informed decision.

I visited this restaurant with my friends, and unfortunately, the experience was very poor. We ordered non-vegetarian food, and it was not properly cleaned or prepared. The worst part was realizing that they were serving leftover food. When we asked about their specialty, they only suggested items that were already prepared and leftover, so I would strongly advise against asking for their “specials.”

The consequences were serious—after the visit, one of my friends and I suffered from medical issues. This clearly raises concerns about hygiene and food safety.

If you still plan to visit, please make sure the food being served is fresh. Personally, I do not recommend this place at all. The food quality is very poor, it is unsafe for health, and not worth the money.

Such repeated negligence and insensitive behavior show a lack of basic food handling discipline and customer respect. Highly unreliable place for vegetarian customers.

featured_reviews.name: Sanil Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
😋 A Flavorful Experience at The Wings Restaurant! 😋

After hearing countless rave reviews about The Wings Restaurant, I finally decided to give it a try. Despite initial hesitations due to negative feedback, a friend's insistence led me to visit this gem.

📍Location & Accessibility:
Situated conveniently on the main road, The Wings Restaurant is easily accessible. No hassle in finding it!

👨‍🍳 Service & Hospitality:
The service here is top-notch! The waiters were incredibly courteous, going above and beyond to ensure a pleasant dining experience. I was impressed when the head captain personally attended to my needs, even fetching tissue paper from the box. Talk about attention to detail! 🙌

🍽️ Pre-Meal Treat:
To kick-start our dining adventure, we were pleasantly surprised with a complimentary serving of fried noodles with Schezwan sauce. What a delightful way to whet our appetites!

🍗 Delectable Delights:
Now, onto the main event—the food! We indulged in the Buffalo Wings, which lived up to their name with their generous size and mouthwatering flavor. The Pahadi Kebab was a hit as well, bursting with authentic taste. Though the Chinese Bhel was just okay, the overall spread left us satisfied.

⏱️ Swift Service:
Despite the bustling crowd, the food service was impressively quick. Kudos to the efficient staff for managing even a Tuesday evening rush with ease.

💰 Value for Money:
One of the highlights is definitely the reasonable pricing. The rates are on the lower side, considering the quality and quantity of the food served. No wonder so many people flock here for a delicious meal!

👏 Overall Experience:
In conclusion, The Wings Restaurant exceeded my expectations in every aspect. From the warm hospitality to the lip-smacking dishes, it's a culinary haven worth revisiting. I can only imagine the bustling atmosphere on weekends—I'll definitely be back for more! 🌟
